_README: Copy to config/local.json and fill in what this machine needs. Every key is optional: an unset key falls through to a bundled asset, then to platform probes. Each value can also be supplied as an EXPERIMENT_REPORT_GRADER_* environment variable (name in brackets) or a command-line flag, and flags win.
[EXPERIMENT_REPORT_GRADER_SIGNATURE_FILE: annotated signature PDF or transparent PNG for approved write-back
[EXPERIMENT_REPORT_GRADER_SIGNATURE_PDF]: legacy variable; also accepts a transparent PNG
[EXPERIMENT_REPORT_GRADER_SCORE_FONT]: handwriting face for the score written into 成绩评定
[EXPERIMENT_REPORT_GRADER_PYTHON]: interpreter used to run this skill's own scripts
[EXPERIMENT_REPORT_GRADER_NODE]: Node.js, needed by the local review panel service
[EXPERIMENT_REPORT_GRADER_OCR_EXECUTABLE: OCR helper, normally generated by scripts/setup_local_ocr.sh
[EXPERIMENT_REPORT_GRADER_PDFTOPPM_EXECU: PDF page renderer used by local OCR
